channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Copperfell
item.description: Journey to Copperfell, a vast magical land teeming with charming villages, interesting characters, and dangerous monsters. Grind 24 skills, craft a huge variety of items, and grow stronger as you explore. Get those level 100s, will you?

item.title: Cubic Odyssey
item.description: Embark on a galactic journey in Cubic Odyssey, an open-world adventure where you explore vibrant planets, craft tools, build vehicles, and fight the Red Darkness. Uncover ancient mysteries, and shape a universe full of life, danger, and limitless possibilities!

item.title: Ghost in the SQL Data
item.description: A call reported a school fire 14 minutes before the first witness saw it. Find out who made it, in SQL, by exploring a year of Paris emergency calls.

item.title: Hunting Simulator 3
item.description: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.

item.title: Hunting Simulator 3 - Classic American Hunter Pack
item.description: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.

item.title: A Place for Every Potion
item.description: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.

item.title: Aces of Thunder
item.description: Experience the thrill of aerial combat with Aces of Thunder, the ultimate flight simulation game with high fidelity graphics that looks perfect both with and without VR HMDs.

item.title: Airport Contraband
item.description: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?

item.title: ANOMALITH
item.description: “ANOMALITH” is a survival third-person shooter set in Japan, steeped in the atmosphere of liminal spaces and Showa-era retro aesthetics. To search for her missing friend, a girl steps into a world writhing with anomalies.

item.title: Broke Wizards
item.description: A 2–6 player competitive sandbox party game where wizard roommates vie to make rent! Slay monsters, play prop hunt, race hoverboards, and take on crazy jobs to pay your giant Imp Landlord first!

item.title: Crab Champions
item.description: Claw your way across exotic islands combining fluid movement with fast paced combat to become a Crab Champion in this third person roguelike shooter.

item.title: Europa Universalis V
item.description: Use war, trade or diplomacy to satisfy your grandest ambitions and dominate five centuries of history in the newest version of Europa Universalis, Paradox Interactive's flagship historical grand strategy game.

item.title: Everlast: Undying Tale
item.description: On Everlast: Undying Tale’s magical world of Sarkis, the undead have risen. Gather, explore, skill, and craft in this MMO-Lite Action RPG Adventure. Only by bridging the gap between the living and the dead can you break Death’s curse.

item.title: Fantasy World Manager
item.description: Create a vast, living fantasy world: heroes, creatures, quests and events; cultures, religions and factions; overworlds, interiors and dungeons-filled with stories, wars and choices.

item.title: Geoplanetical
item.description: A geopolitical simulation that starts on January 1, 2026, with the world as it stood that day. Govern one of 200+ nations and territories, or lead its opposition: laws, budget, elections, strikes, diplomacy, war. The other governments never wait for you. No scenarios, no end date.

item.title: Lakeburg Legacies
item.description: Take fate into your own hands in Lakeburg Legacies, a social-based village management sim where love is your favourite resource. Play matchmaker to create the most effective, and most loved up, couples and help your kingdom thrive. How long will it take you to crown a sovereign?

item.title: Neuron Activation
item.description: A digital fidget box of dopamine-fueled micro-challenges. Push buttons. Shoot targets. Chain actions for higher scores. Complete all tasks. Don’t ask questions.

item.title: PC Cafe Simulator
item.description: Run your own Korean PC cafe! From customer service to cooking and store management — experience life as a PC cafe owner. Start small, hire staff, expand your store, and deal with troublesome customers yourself! Play solo or co-op with up to 8 players.

item.title: President Simulator
item.description: Become President of the USA: sign absurd decrees and balance your policies to avoid being called a "sellout." Communicate to gain popularity, manage interviews, and face press conferences. Everything falling apart? Press the red button.

item.title: Probably Stolen - Cyberpunk Shopkeeper Sim
item.description: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and decide how far you’re willing to go to stay afloat. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.

item.title: Quarantine Lab Sort
item.description: Restore order to a lab left in complete chaos! Sort over 7,000 items, examine unknown samples in a centrifuge, catch escaped animals, and handle radioactive waste with care. Unlock skills and turn piles of clutter into neatly organized shelves.

item.title: Rug Cleaning Simulator
item.description: Turn filthy rugs into spotless transformations in a relaxing first-person cleaning simulator. Take on customer jobs, clean rugs step by step, earn money, upgrade your equipment, and grow your own rug-cleaning business.

item.title: The Classrooms
item.description: The Classrooms is a procedural, liminal-space, found-footage, survival horror game. Explore The Classrooms and discover the various anomalies it contains; from malicious entities, to harmless oddities. And remember, it's different every time you play, so your found footage is uniquely yours.

item.title: Popcorn & Premieren - Ausgehviertel
item.description: Expand your cinema with a leisure district featuring a pizzeria, beach club, restaurant, ice cream café, arcade, bowling, mini golf, stage and event hall. Upgrade businesses, manage your investment and collect parking fees, with real financial risks as well as opportunities.
